post.summary: Generate a text completion with a USD cost cap
post.description: The default quote covers 32000 output tokens. DeepInfra defaults to an explicit 16384-token channel limit. Explicit caller limits are preserved. Read chat/quote before submission and supply maxCostUsd. Reuse Idempotency-Key with an identical body to retrieve the saved JSON or SSE receipt. Unknown outcomes retain the original reservation. Missing usage preserves output. A minimum equal to the accepted cap is settled deterministically. Larger unresolved fees enter verified usage review. Query recordInfo using X-I2V-Task-Id.

200.description: OpenAI-compatible completion or SSE stream with a persistent USD billing identity.
